result.topic_en: Formulas for the Mercator projection (unit radius) relating plane coordinates to spherical latitude, the scale factor, and the spherical distance and inclination angles between two points, with complex-variable forms and an approximation formula.
result.transcription:
234
Mercators Projection
$x, x'$ Abscissen
$y, y'$ Ordinaten
$u, u'$ den Ordinaten entsprechende Bögen
$s$ Entfernung der beiden Punkte $x, y$ ; $x', y'$ von einander in Bogen.
$\theta, \theta'$ Neigungswinkel von $s$, oder von den Tangenten, an den beiden Endpunkten gegen die Abscissenlinie
Halbmesser immer $=1$
$y = \log\tang(45^\circ + \tfrac12 u)$ \quad $\cos\tfrac12 iy = \frac{\cos\frac12 u}{\sqrt{\cos u}} = \cos\tfrac12 u \sqrt{\cos iy}$
$\tang\tfrac12 iy = i\tang\tfrac12 u$
$\sin iy = i\tang u$
$\tang iy = i\sin u$
$\cos iy = \frac{1}{\cos u}$ ... Vergrösserungsverhältniss
$\cos\tfrac12(x'-x).\sin\tfrac12 i(y'-y) = i\sin\tfrac12(\theta+\theta')\sin\tfrac12 s\sqrt{\cos iy.\cos iy'}$
$\sin\tfrac12(x'-x).\cos\tfrac12 i(y'-y) = \cos\tfrac12(\theta+\theta')\sin\tfrac12 s.\sqrt{\cos iy.\cos iy'}$
$\cos\tfrac12(x'-x)\cos\tfrac12 i(y'+y) = \cos\tfrac12(\theta-\theta').\cos\tfrac12 s.\sqrt{\cos iy.\cos iy'}$
$\sin\tfrac12(x'-x)\sin\tfrac12 i(y'+y) = i\sin\tfrac12(\theta-\theta').\cos\tfrac12 s\sqrt{\cos iy.\cos iy'}$
$x+iy = t$ \quad $x'+iy' = t'$ \quad [-$\sqrt{\cos iy.\cos iy'} = h$-]
$\sin\tfrac12(t'-t) = h\, e^{-\frac12 i(\theta+\theta')}\sin\tfrac12 s$ [-$\cos\tfrac12$-] \quad $\sqrt{\cos iy.\cos iy'} = h$
[-$\sin\tfrac12(t+t)$ =-][?]
$i\,\mathrm{tg}\tfrac12(\theta+\theta') = \frac{\mathrm{tg}\frac12 i(y'-y)}{\mathrm{tg}\frac12(x'-x)}$
$i\,\mathrm{tg}\tfrac12(\theta-\theta') = \mathrm{tg}\tfrac12(x'-x).\mathrm{tg}\tfrac12 i(y'+y)$ \quad cf. grünes Buch
Hinreichend genau ist immer
$\left(1 + \tfrac{1}{48}\{(x'-x)^2 - (y'-y)^2\}\right)\sqrt{(x'-x)^2+(y'-y)^2} = h\sin\tfrac12 s$
